title: Fix bugs in a Go JSON response builder
description: A Go HTTP response helper has three bugs: wrong status code for not-found, missing Content-Type header, and JSON marshaling error not checked. Fix all three.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix the bugs in response.go:

1. BUG 1 in WriteJSON: Add `w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")` BEFORE calling w.WriteHeader()
2. BUG 2 in NotFound: Change http.StatusBadRequest to http.StatusNotFound

Run `go test ./...` to verify all 3 tests pass.
success_criteria: Content-Type header is set to application/json
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `go test ./...` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
